title: bagframe
summary: Plain B toggles only the backpack; Shift+B toggles all occupied normal bags; tested lifecycle transitions emit exactly one expected named cue; representative bag-bar and equipped-bag portrait icons are strictly contained. Item hover uses ContainerFrameItemButton_OnEnter's exact opposite-screen-side seat. Container item slots render UI-Quickslot-Depress while held, and the keyring button now swaps to its cropped Down atlas while pushed and adds its cropped additive Highlight atlas while hovered. Overall reference parity is not yet established.

openItems.text: Implemented but needs live-session verification. Use, player-array swap, bag swap, and stack split now have exact build-5875 opcodes, endpoint selection, and byte ordering with deterministic regression coverage.

Implemented but needs live-session verification. Whole-item carry/place, context action, Shift-split, same-slot cancel, and drag source/receive use one tested routing law and the shared inventory move dispatcher.
Implemented but needs live-session verification. Opposite-side item tooltips and tested Buy/Inspect cursor priority are wired through the shared inventory hover path.

Implemented but needs live-session verification. Slot icons, NumberFontNormal counts, ring, depressed state, hover highlight, lock dimming, and item cooldown/finish flash are present; pixel acceptance is not yet captured.
Implemented but needs live-session verification. Live slot 1 maps to physical button N, physical button 1 remains bottom-right, and plus-two top rows right-align exactly for every container capacity.

Implemented but needs live-session verification. Backpack, generalized equipped-bag, and keyring windows now use the exact one-row, plus-two, multi-row, middle, and bottom texture laws with original assets and authored titles.

Implemented but needs live-session verification. Container transitions centralize open order, checked state, Escape closure, and the exact named backpack/keyring open and close cues; batch transitions play exactly one sound.

Implemented but needs live-session verification. Shift+B/OpenAllBags closes all normal bags when any is open, otherwise opens backpack plus every equipped non-empty bag; plain B independently toggles only the backpack.

Implemented but needs live-session verification. The five normal bag buttons now bind live icons, rings, checked/hover states, lock tint, and the current OpenAllBags binding; rendered acceptance remains.
Implemented but needs live-session verification. Equipped-bag buttons use a tested toggle/place/no-op decision law and the shared equipment endpoint for click and drag placement.

Implemented but needs live-session verification. The distinct -2 keyring path is implemented end-to-end: descriptor fields, BagFamily parsing, HasKey gate, 4/8/12/16 capacity, wire slots 81-96, window/button art, sounds, and first-empty drop with full refusal.

Implemented but needs live-session verification. SMSG_ITEM_PUSH_RESULT now restarts the exact one-second alpha/scale/drop animation on its resolved backpack, equipped-bag, or keyring button; rendered acceptance remains.

Implemented but needs live-session verification. Game-menu state now disables and greys the backpack plus four equipped-bag controls while retaining rings and excluding the keyring from Disable_BagButtons; visual acceptance remains.
